description: Read the state of a listing request and what to do next: the domain-proof options, the prepared draft with its revision digest (facts, which of them are company statements, what ACI checked itself, open questions), the Listing Terms the company accepts with its approval (listing_terms: version, url, sha256, summary), or the public URL once published (also while an update of it is being prepared). Show the user the draft and the Listing Terms summary with its link before asking for approval.
name: get_listing_status
title: Get listing status
